title: Índicos — Multi-Tenant Referral Marketing SaaS Platform
subtitle: First Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture, Dynamic Subdomains & Referral Graph Visualization
summary: Full multi-tenant referral marketing SaaS in Laravel featuring dynamic subdomain isolation, custom middleware routing, multi-level commission logic, and dynamic hierarchy network graphs.
overview: The Índicos project was founded on the vision of democratizing referral marketing, enabling companies of any size to independently manage automated multi-level rewards programs. The engineering core was building a multi-tenant SaaS platform from scratch where each tenant operated in an isolated scope via dynamic subdomains (e.g., company.indicos.com.br) powered by a single centralized Laravel application. Custom routing middlewares served as the platform gateway, resolving tenant contexts per HTTP request and isolating user authentication, business commission logic, and relational MySQL persistence.
responsibilities: Multi-Tenant Architecture: Designed and implemented from-scratch tenant boundary isolation and dynamic subdomain routing.
Commissioning Engine: Programmed the business rules governing multi-level compensation, reward criteria, and payment distribution.
Interactive Dashboards: Built real-time network graphs visualizing hierarchical referral trees directly inside client dashboards.
Infrastructure Problem Solving: Diagnosed hosting provider edge limitations to establish reliable wildcard subdomain resolution.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Configuring dynamic wildcard subdomains on constrained hosting environments with restrictive reverse proxy setups.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Conducted deep HTTP host header analysis, implementing custom middleware fallback logic to ensure reliable tenant resolution.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Rendering multi-level network hierarchies in real-time without client-side lag or memory exhaustion.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Developed an optimized recursive tree generator in the backend with incremental DOM visualization in the browser.

owaspMitigations.title: Broken Access Control
owaspMitigations.description: Tenant context verified at middleware layer on every request, preventing cross-tenant data leakage.

owaspMitigations.title: Injection
owaspMitigations.description: Strict Eloquent ORM bindings across all dynamic tenant database queries.

owaspMitigations.title: Identification and Authentication Failures
